CreateMicroVMImage.documentation: Creates a new microVM image with the specified configuration and code artifact

GetAuthorizationContext.name: GetAuthorizationContext

LaunchMicroVM.name: LaunchMicroVM
LaunchMicroVM.documentation: Launches a MicroVM from the provided MicroVM Image.

ListManagedMicroVMImageVersions.name: ListManagedMicroVMImageVersions
ListManagedMicroVMImageVersions.documentation: Lists major versions and ARNs for a specific managed Virtual Machine Image.

ListManagedMicroVMImages.documentation: Lists available managed mVMIs for an account.

ListMicroVMImageBuilds.name: ListMicroVMImageBuilds
ListMicroVMImageBuilds.documentation: Lists builds for a specific MicroVM image version with optional filtering by architecture and chipset characteristics.

ListMicroVMImageVersions.name: ListMicroVMImageVersions
ListMicroVMImageVersions.documentation: Lists all versions for a specific MicroVM image with optional filtering by state, sorted by creation time.

ListMicroVMs.name: ListMicroVMs
ListMicroVMs.documentation: Returns MicroVMs by calling ListApplicationInstances and converting the response format. This operation provides a MicroVM-compatible interface over the existing ApplicationInstance data.

SuspendMicroVM.name: SuspendMicroVM
SuspendMicroVM.documentation: Suspends the given MicroVM. This operation only acknowledges the request to suspend the MicroVM. The actual MicroVM suspension happens asynchronously.

TerminateMicroVM.name: TerminateMicroVM
TerminateMicroVM.documentation: Terminates the given MicroVM. This operation only acknowledges the request to Terminate the MicroVM. The actual MicroVM termination happens asynchronously.

documentation:
Service for managing Lambda MicroVMs and their microVMImages.

This service provides APIs to create, manage, and operate Lambda MicroVMs and their associated microVMImage environments.
